contact.name: Carey McDonald
contact.evidence_quote: Carey McDonald ... Carey McDonald (they/them) has served as the UUA’s Executive Vice President since 2018, appointed by the Board to Trustees to lead the organization in fulfilling its mission and overseeing day-to-day staff operations. Their role supervises the organization’s Board and governance support; legal counsel; risk management; strategic planning; Human Resources: Equity, Belonging & Change; General Assembly & Conference Services; Global Connections; New UU Communities; the UU Funding Program; and Beacon

alternates.evidence_quote: Ashley Horan ... The Rev. Ashley Horan (she/her) serves as the Vice President for Programs and Ministries, overseeing and coordinating the UUA’s primary programs and ministries in alignment with the UUA’s mission and values. Ashley oversees the major programmatic staff groups doing outward-facing work with UUA constituents, including the Ministries and Faith Development, Congregational Life (regional staff), and Organizing Strategy/Side With Love staff teams.
